decisions.reason: Even though the accelerator is peripheral to the core machinery business, it extends the firm's advisory offer and, having already been kept once, management is likely to justify the initial commitment and continue it in a growing firm.

Because the bio-based CO2-negative binder was presented as a flagship tied to the firm's circular, lower-emission direction, the public commitment and accumulated investment make management reluctant to withdraw it despite some fit risk with the machinery core.
The infectious waste decontamination plant is close to the firm's technological base and was launched very visibly as a strategic advance, so escalation of commitment strongly favors retaining it.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant fits the firm's decentralized recycling strategy and established engineering capabilities, and after another year on the market management would usually persist rather than reverse course.
